fusions.name: From Nowhere
fusions.desc: Springs at a target at or below 25% health up to 7 tiles away for 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Fur Flying
fusions.desc: Claws and bites every enemy within 2 tiles and deals 7 damage, with a 30% chance each to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Quiet Stalk
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 22% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Twist Away
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 4% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
